items.quote: I needed electric work done after a house inspection. Cape City was competitive with their pricing and were able to fit me onto the schedule within a few days. Very happy with the work done. Fast, professional and easy to communicate with.

Jermaine installed a generator plug on my external wall. He is extremely knowledgeable, very accommodating with my schedule, and made great suggestions. He was prompt and showed up on time, did a fantastic job, and had the best quote.
Jermaine and Isabel were amazing! They had clear communication, responded quickly, very fair pricing, and were able to get my beautiful fans up. Could not recommend them more!
